lore:
The triumphal procession has always been a grand celebration for the Romans.
White doves, laurel leaves, and golden confetti flying in the air... all of this is related to the warriors, yet unrelated.
Together with captives from Gaul, Alexandria, and Parthia, he was bound to a heavy cross and paraded through the streets.
This is a staple of the triumph. The warrior is mocked relentlessly, simply because he is deemed a bloody accomplice of the deceased emperor.
Shame, anger, or hatred? No, none of these.
The warrior has no emotions and no thoughts.
He only smells blood.
